name: fsevents_parse
description: Read /.fseventsd record files: the per-volume log of file creations, deletions, renames and modifications that macOS writes whether anyone wants it or not. Returns each path with its event id and decoded flags. Order, not time.

path.description: An /.fseventsd directory, or one record file

flags.description: Keep only records carrying these flags, e.g. ["Removed","Renamed"]
